case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for our reliable cooperation. We appreciate the cost context you shared and have considered the indices you cited alongside your proposed price, payment terms and contract term. Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR 403.21 per unit before margin (cost:350020).

We would like to find terms that work for both sides. Our counterproposal is EUR 400.74 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. The longer contract term would give you greater planning security while providing a sound basis for our continued cooperation. We welcome your thoughts on this proposal.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our list price stays as it is, but on the terms we have room - that is where we can meet you.

Our Angebot is a price of €431.92 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. The contract term is reflected in the price. Below this price we would need facts, not just a lower number. Any further step needs approval from our management.

As an alternative option, for a binding 5496 pcs per year: €426.35, under the following terms: a price of €426.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 5496 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for reviewing our should-cost data and for moving towards us on your offer. We understand that your list price remains unchanged and that a further step would require management approval. We also appreciate the alternative tied to a binding higher annual volume. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 expects 4,580 units a year, a change of +10.3 %. That is the volume figure we can put forward, rather than the binding volume in your alternative. On that basis, we can improve our proposal to EUR 407.09 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Would you be willing to take this proposal to your management for consideration?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for reviewing the volume data and for offering revised terms. We appreciate your flexibility on payment and contract length, and we understand that your management has frozen price reductions. We have considered both your offer at €431.71 per unit and the €426.14 alternative tied to a binding higher volume. Our proposal remains based on the volume in your first offer.

You asked for facts to support a lower price. Your rolling twelve-month on-time delivery in 2026Q3 was 84.6 % (sc:70530@2026Q3). In light of this delivery performance, our revised offer is EUR 415.90 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Could you meet us on these terms? We value our working relationship and welcome your response.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
